project.name: Kafka-java
project.description: A Java distributed message queue with broker, producer, and consumer modes over TCP, inspired by Kafka-style topics and consumer groups.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see how to launch broker, producer, and consumer modes with Gradle.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Application.main routes CLI args into broker, producer, or consumer startup paths.

tour.title: Broker and Topic Model
tour.description: The broker owns topics; each topic has a ring-buffer queue and consumer groups protected by locks.

tour.title: Producer and Consumer Clients
tour.description: Clients listen on their own ports, register with the broker, then exchange messages on dedicated TCP connections.

tour.title: Wire Protocol
tour.description: Messages are length-prefixed frames with typed opcodes; registration requests encode port and topic identifiers.
